comment: Routing table for rule V12: each kind of gap has exactly one home criterion (key "row"). 'patterns' are optional regular expressions that let the script recognise a topic when the model set none.

loi_drift.description: A promised question, dataset, analysis or comparison is missing or changed without explanation

secondary_aim_equal_billing.description: A secondary aim gets equal billing with the primary aim

analysis_unconnected_to_aim.description: An analysis does not connect to the primary aim

causal_language.description: Causal wording, mechanism claims in the Results, results read against outside events

causal_design.description: A design built to identify an effect (event study, diff-in-diff, discontinuity, placebo test …)

population_or_unit_undefined.description: Population or unit of analysis is not explicit; non-coverage not stated

inclusion_rule_missing.description: No inclusion rule for the main data or a subset behind a headline claim

n_missing_or_inconsistent.description: Ns of the data or its subsets are missing or do not reconcile

coverage_not_characterized.description: What the source covers or misses is not measured, estimated or benchmarked

collection_differences_unaligned.description: Compared waves, samples or sources differ in how they were collected, and this is not aligned

measure_not_validated.description: A measure is not validated, or not suited to the text type, language, period or platform

measure_not_justified.description: A constructed measure, threshold, category scheme or proxy is not explained or justified

sensitivity_to_analytic_choice.description: A headline number is not shown under reasonable alternative choices

classifier_error_in_prevalence.description: Classifier error is not carried into a prevalence estimate

uncertainty_missing.description: A key quantity lacks intervals or the relevant variation; interval type or subgroup n missing

group_difference_without_variation.description: A difference between groups is asserted without the variation needed to read it

skewed_quantity_as_mean.description: A skewed quantity is reported only as a mean

findings_not_first.description: Title, abstract, introduction or section openings do not lead with findings

methods_scattered.description: Methods are not in one findable place

length_mismatch.description: Main-text length does not match what the paper delivers

tutorial_or_tool_material.description: Space goes to tutorials on standard techniques, tool advertising, raw lists, loosely related analyses

tool_comparison_as_finding.description: A comparison of tools or models is presented as a finding

figure_or_caption_unclear.description: A figure or table is not self-contained (caption, N, encodings, denominators, axes)

cross_reference_error.description: A reference to a figure, table or section is wrong

no_citable_baseline.description: Findings do not answer the question in a form others can cite

no_comparison_point.description: A headline number has no comparison point

literature_scope_mismatch.description: The literature is broader or narrower than the claims

background_never_narrows.description: Background that never narrows to the questions asked

related_work_missing.description: Specific, closely related work is not engaged with

text_figure_mismatch.description: Text and a figure or table disagree about a result

overclaiming.description: A claim outruns the evidence: tentative results stated as findings, unmeasured things asserted, generalization beyond the units

limitations_generic.description: Limitations do not say which estimates are affected or in which direction

end_matter_missing.description: Keywords, availability statement, acknowledgments, funding or ethics information is missing

citation_inconsistency.description: Citation format is inconsistent or in-text citations are missing from the reference list
